MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Partners and Duets appeal to me because shared vocals and musical collaborations connect with my interest in polished vocal groups and ensemble singing.",
    "Traveller feels worth trying because 747 and Golden show that country music also has a place in my listening."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "25 and Adele 21 have appealing vocals, but that alone does not make them my choice today; I want something closer to my orchestral and ensemble vocal favorites. In The Lonely Hour does not fit that mood either.",
    "Elvis: Ultimate Gospel and Eagles: The Very Best Of give me little reason to expect the soothing classical or collaborative vocal listening I currently want.",
    "Noel and Home for Christmas fit my occasional seasonal listening, but I would save them for when I want Christmas music."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Having an expressive singer seems to count too heavily when the accompaniment and the way voices work together matter to me too.",
    "My Christmas purchases seem to be treated as an ongoing listening preference rather than something I return to on particular occasions."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent choice, The Most Relaxing Classical Music in the Universe, suggests a desire for calm listening that I do not hear reflected strongly enough in these choices.",
    "The connection among my vocal groups, Stages, and Downton Abbey music matters more to me today than a broad connection to well-known singers."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The choices recognize my interest in vocals and country, but miss how much calm orchestral music, voices together, and the occasion shape what I want now."
}
